written_exceptions: EngineLegacyWall: explicit >80-line exception in CutPlan section 3 and source_check.md; no presumption that 8.4 has retired it.
Adapt: <=80 lines is a phase-D completion requirement, not an end-of-B gate.
Pre-existing Selection and MeshOptimizer bodies remain outside this cut; old main-file functions are baseline, not new-file exemptions.
detection_limitations: Lexical scanner, not a compiler or full C++ parser; templates, requires clauses, macros, function-try-blocks, operator forms, raw strings, conditional preprocessing and brace-initialized constructor members may be missed or misclassified.
Reports potential constructor initializer lists separately for manual inspection; call/definition distinction is heuristic.
Formatted lengths count from detected signature line (and contiguous template/return-type line) through its closing brace; actual compiler scope is not proved.
Lambdas in unmodified main are inventoried but are not automatically classified as new; review candidate B8 setup_finish against the 15-line rule separately.
Private-unit overlay is synthetic until B6/B7/B8 are accepted; do not treat it as production or gate evidence.
